10442598.en: {name|B} leads you by the hand to a quiet, secluded spot where you sit side by side. She gazes at you deeply before taking your hand and gently leaning against you. Time seems to stand still as you both remain there, listening to the chirping birds and feeling the soft breeze caress your skin.

10442599.en: Suddenly, {name|B}'s hand emanates a drawing force, extracting the stagnant energy in you. As the darkness within you dissipates, some of your negative Destinies fade away with it.

10442600.en: Thank you for staying with me...

10442601.en: The frost within me can neutralize toxic energy, so this won't harm me much. What matters most is... that you're safe now... I'm fine, really.

10442602.en: A bittersweet expression crosses {name|B}'s face as she gives you a gentle smile and waves goodbye.

10442603.en: A cultivator approaches from afar, trembling as he hands you a box of Elixirs.

10442604.en: Please take this, fellow cultivator... It's s-so c-cold...

10442606.en: Alright, I yield! I surrender! I'm no match for your frost energy. What do you want from me?

10442607.en: Deliver this item to {name|A} for me.

10442610.en: To think she'd threaten me so brazenly... Ah. I have only myself to blame for being too weak...

10442611.en: Go ask her yourself, how would I know?

10442612.en: All I know is that if I don't do what she says, she might turn me into an ice sculpture. Whatever's going on between you two, I don't want to know—I'm just an innocent bystander!

10442613.en: Ahem... But you know what? I get the feeling that the icy lady of yours just wants you to visit her more often and talk with her.

10442614.en: Message delivered. I'll take my leave now. So cold...

10442615.en: A sudden gust of frigid wind sweeps through. In the distance, a graceful female cultivator walks along the path. As the mountain mist parts, she turns her gaze toward you—it's {name|B}.

10442616.en: Y-you? What are you doing here? Oh right—I've been searching for ways to control my internal frost energy lately, and I found some divine herbs. I made this with them... please take it.

10442617.en: {name|B} speaks with an icy tone, but her fair cheeks flush slightly as she hands you the item. Trying to hide her embarrassment, she hastily pushes it into your hands before turning and hurrying away.

10442618.en: W-what are you doing here? I-I wasn't following you or anything! How have you been lately? The world of cultivators is full of schemes, deception, and countless dangers. Please take care of yourself.

10442619.en: After rushing through her words, the maiden's fair cheeks turn rosy. She quickly turns away, practically fleeing from the scene.

10442620.en: I often dream of the day when I can finally purge this frost energy from my body. Then I won't have to fear others coming close to me, and then you and I could... walk around together, spend time together... W-what am I saying?! H-here, take this. I'm leaving! Take care of yourself.

10442621.en: You spend quite some time at {name|B}'s home. Not wanting to disturb you, she quietly retreats to her inner chamber. After a long while, she returns to your side, slowly sitting down to keep you company in peaceful silence.

10442622.en: H-hey, I made some food while you were spacing out. Would you try some? I-it's not like I'm being nice to you or anything! It's just that with my unique constitution, I'm worried these might have some adverse effects, so I need you to test them first.

10442623.en: As {name|B} finishes speaking, a faint blush colors her cheeks. She places the items in your hands before hastily retreating to her inner chamber.

10442624.en: What intrigues me is that Chi You must be hiding tremendous secrets. Unfortunately, these Nether Demons keep harassing me, making it impossible to properly investigate the ley lines.

10442625.en: Hmph, I'm about to go hunt some Nether Demons. If you're free, you might as well come along.

10442626.en: Ahead, the Nether Demon howls wildly at the sky. Beside you, {name|B} coldly observes the monster, calculating the perfect moment to strike it down in one fell swoop.

10442627.en: Heaven shows no favor; all beings are equal... but you brought this upon yourself by crossing my path!

10442628.en: The defeated Nether Demon stares at you both in disbelief. Without a word, Tianxiang steps forward and waves her sleeve, instantly reducing the demon to scattered ashes.

10442629.en: Hmph, I look forward to hunting Nether Demons with you again.

10442630.en: {name|B}, usually so cold and distant, gives you a gentle smile before turning to leave.

10442631.en: Just as you're taking down a notice from the Bounty Board, you sense something unusual. Looking around, you spot a Nether Demon suspended in midair, tightly bound by spider silk.

10442632.en: Don't trouble yourself—I've brought the Nether Demon to you.

10442633.en: {name|B} finishes speaking with a slight smile, then vanishes without a trace.

10442634.en: You've been standing in Chi You for a while when dark clouds suddenly gather overhead, unleashing a torrential downpour. At that moment, someone quietly approaches and raises an umbrella to shield you from the storm. Though her expression remains distant, she stays silently by your side, unmoved even as the rain grows heavier.

10442635.en: Oh? Back to your senses? It's rather careless to space out like that in Chi You—this is the most dangerous region in all the world, after all. Do take care of yourself.

10442636.en: Seeing you've come to your senses, {name|B} closes her umbrella and steps away into the distance.

10442637.en: {name|A}, your very existence torments me! Today, we shall settle our old scores once and for all!

10442638.en: With a fierce cry, the cultivator channels their energy and charges at you. Suddenly, silver threads slice through the air, instantly binding their limbs. Before they can struggle free, the threads yank upward with tremendous force, hurling them into the distant mountains. Their screams fade into nothing as they disappear from sight...

10442639.en: You look into the distance and catch a glimpse of {name|B}'s graceful silhouette as she walks away, vanishing in the blink of an eye.

10442640.en: Your {relation|C|A} {name|C} is a person of poor character, with countless misde—

10442641.en: Before they can continue, threads of silk slice through the air and seal their mouth shut. Caught off guard and unable to continue their slander, they frantically try to tear away the spider silk. But the web, woven with special techniques, refuses to budge. Drenched in sweat from their futile struggles, they stagger away in panic.

10442642.en: Much more peaceful now, wouldn't you say?

10442643.en: {name|B} gives you a gentle smile before turning to leave. A shadow flickers, and she melts into the distance, vanishing from sight.

10442644.en: The Way of Heaven is eternal, flowing on without end. Perhaps our bond could be the same? Humans have this custom of exchanging gifts to strengthen their friendships. Please take these.

10442645.en: Last month, some Nether Demons were prowling around my Silken Cottage, making an awful racket. I dealt with them, of course. The Battle Contribution is useless to me, so you can have them all.

10442646.en: As {name|B} methodically explains each difficult concept in the manual, you gain new insight and master its contents in one swift enlightenment.

10442652.en: Do not take such a risk

10442659.en: Who's the one to take you back?

10442661.en: Tell me what you want first

10442668.en: What do you want to do?

10442680.en: Why are you trembling so much?

10442687.en: Alas. Another failed batch of alchemy... Though I'm deeply disappointed, I won't wallow in self-pity. I know you're always there, supporting me silently. And I... I will overcome this obstacle...

10442688.en: However, the pill shows no effect whatsoever—your body remains completely unchanged.

10442689.en: Let's go! I love going outdoors!

10442690.en: What to do with Ao Yao?

10442691.en: What to do with Ao Yao?

10442692.en: What to do with Ao Yao?

10442694.en: You're here! I've been waiting for you for so long! Shall we go over there?

10442695.en: Father says that playing Go can reveal the mysteries of yin and yang, and teach one when to advance or retreat. But I think it is just a game, and having a competitive spirit only makes your play inferior. Ahem... You know what I mean, right? You must not win me in playing that game! Hehe!

10442696.en: Hey, you've become much better at playing Go! Have you been practicing in secret?

10442697.en: I don't really understand profound principles and such. But if you want to debate, I'll chat with you about it for a bit!

10442698.en: To temporarily set aside all my worries and take a cup of tea... It's truly a rare pleasure.

10442699.en: Next time I want you to come with me again to have tea! We'll spend a whole day savoring it—no, a whole month!

10442700.en: Look! These fish swimming freely must be carefree and happy, don't you think so?

10442701.en: Their joyful life makes me quite envious.

10442702.en: You want to have a drink? Ha! I secretly snagged some of Minister Turtle's private Whalesong Wine when I was back last time. Shall we try a little bit right now?

10442703.en: It tastes pretty good, right? Next time I go home, I'll bring some more from our palace!

10442704.en: Let's go! We're going to see the little flowers!

10442705.en: I always used to think the coral on the seafloor, with all its brilliant colors and strange shapes, was breathtakingly beautiful. But actually, these flowers here, blooming in such vibrant purples and reds, are quite lovely too.

10442706.en: Alright, but remember to be gentle with such a delicate little lady like me! We're just having a friendly contest!

10442707.en: You know what? Actually, I'm not really that much of a troublemaker. Sometimes I just use making mischief and fooling around as an excuse to see you.

10442708.en: I know! Your sect will be the greatest, and someday you'll become the supreme sect leader of the world!

10442709.en: Righteous and evil often lie in a single thought. Where in this world can you find completely good or bad ones? Whether you follow the Righteous path or the other, as long as you're truly being yourself, I'll cherish you all the same.

10442710.en: You're so diligent—even here, you're still thinking about cultivation. Fine, I'll keep you company. But I must say in advance, I'm not going to sit there concentrating seriously the whole time. When I get bored, you'll have to come play with me again!

10442711.en: For me? Really? You're not allowed to take it back! Alright then, I will accept your gift for a princess without any pretense! Hehe!

10442712.en: Hey... we'll come play again next time, what do you say? And, and... don't make me wait for so long... alright?

10442713.en: Oh? What is this about? Inviting me out? Hmm, I was supposed to read three books and take two tomes of notes today. But since this is such a heartfelt invitation, I will accept.

10442714.en: What to do with Lan You?

10442715.en: What to do with Lan You?

10442716.en: What to do with Lan You?

10442718.en: Hey, my duncie. Shall we go play over there?

10442719.en: Playing Go? Isn't that just making things difficult for me? I really don't like having to think so hard.

10442720.en: Not bad at all, my duncie! You're quite clever for making that tactful move. I had to rack my brains to keep my advantage.

10442721.en: I love debates the most, my duncie. Let's begin!

10442722.en: Tea tasting? Huh, you really understand me well—you know I have a taste for this.

10442723.en: Let's stop the tea here. If we drink it all now, you won't come looking for me next time, my good duncie.

10442724.en: These little fish in the lake travel no more than half a mile, and even when they flick their tails and turn about, they only stir up tiny ripples within arm's reach. I've heard tell of the Kun-peng of the vast seas—swimming the northern ocean at dawn, reaching the Cangwu giant tree by dusk, and can stir up waves as tall as mountains. There's truly a world of difference between them.

10442725.en: My duncie, with all your abilities, you're actually a great one that roams the vast seas and lurks in the deep. One day you'll overturn the heavens and rule supreme over your domain, don't you think?

10442726.en: I usually don't drink, but since it's you inviting me, little duncie, I'll make an exception and have a couple of drinks.

10442727.en: Let's call it here for today. If we keep drinking, I won't be able to handle any more alcohol.
